title: Mistral AI Studio API key (unprefixed): one-property twin (context)
summary: 12 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: CODESTRAL_API_KEY renamed CODESTRAL_TRACE_ID, an identifier name; the value is kept byte-for-byte, context: MISTRAL_API_KEY renamed MISTRAL_KEY_ID, an identifier name; the value is kept byte-for-byte, and context: the Mistral constructor replaced by an unrelated Widget constructor; the value is kept byte-for-byte, and 5 more. Twin of "Mistral AI Studio API key (unprefixed): must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of mistral-api-key-compose-env: context: MISTRAL_API_KEY renamed MISTRAL_KEY_ID, an identifier name; the value is kept byte-for-byte. The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
